1.0.1: Output labels of nested fields now carry the parent name ("From.Username", "Chat.Username") so the variable picker can tell them apart; schemas mark which fields Telegram guarantees (required) and declare the real chat flags.
DeleteMessage explains Telegram's default permission model (own messages only unless the bot is an admin with the Delete messages right) in the tooltip and in the error.
NewMessage tooltip explains the default privacy mode in groups.

Triggers no longer fail to start when two flows of the same bot start at once: the webhook registration is read first and only written when it differs, and a Telegram 429 on setWebhook is retried after the requested delay.
1.1.0: New Telegram User module (appmixer.telegram.user) that reads public channels as a user account through the official client API (MTProto), so channels the bot is not a member of can be read too. It connects with an API ID and API Hash from my.telegram.org and a pre-generated session string, and never joins the channels it reads.

New Channel Post trigger: new posts in one or more public channels, polled by message ID so posts published while the connection to Telegram was down are delivered once it is back, in order and without duplicates. Only posts published after the flow starts are delivered.
Find Channel Messages: channel history, newest first, with a limit, an after-message-ID filter and a before-date filter for backfill.
Get Channel: title, description, subscriber count, and whether the channel is public, verified or restricted.
Telegram flood control (FLOOD_WAIT) up to 60 seconds is waited out; longer waits are retried later instead of failing the flow. A private, misspelled or non-channel username is reported as an error.
List Chat Administrators labels the nested user fields with the parent name ("User.Username") in the variable picker, like the other components.
Store to CSV file output: the component no longer fails after the file is saved, values with a comma, a quote or a line break are quoted, and empty values stay empty instead of the word null.
